query_name: Total Sales and Total Profit by Year and Quarter
sql_query:
SELECT
  year(o.order_date) AS Year,
  quarter(o.order_date) AS Quarter,
  SUM(o.sales) AS Total_Sales,
  SUM(o.profit) AS Total_Profit
FROM tiger_data_engineering.global_superstore_gold.gold_orders o
GROUP BY year(o.order_date), quarter(o.order_date)
ORDER BY Year, Quarter
description: Unfiltered aggregation of Total Sales and Total Profit by calendar Year and Quarter from the orders table.

query_name: Total Sales by CATEGORY and SUB_CATEGORY
sql_query:
SELECT o.category AS CATEGORY,
  SUM(CASE WHEN o.sub_category = 'Accessories' THEN o.sales ELSE 0 END) AS Accessories,
  SUM(CASE WHEN o.sub_category = 'Appliances' THEN o.sales ELSE 0 END) AS Appliances,
  SUM(CASE WHEN o.sub_category = 'Art' THEN o.sales ELSE 0 END) AS Art,
  SUM(CASE WHEN o.sub_category = 'Binders' THEN o.sales ELSE 0 END) AS Binders,
  SUM(CASE WHEN o.sub_category = 'Bookcases' THEN o.sales ELSE 0 END) AS Bookcases,
  SUM(CASE WHEN o.sub_category = 'Chairs' THEN o.sales ELSE 0 END) AS Chairs,
  SUM(CASE WHEN o.sub_category = 'Copiers' THEN o.sales ELSE 0 END) AS Copiers,
  SUM(CASE WHEN o.sub_category = 'Envelopes' THEN o.sales ELSE 0 END) AS Envelopes,
  SUM(CASE WHEN o.sub_category = 'Fasteners' THEN o.sales ELSE 0 END) AS Fasteners,
  SUM(CASE WHEN o.sub_category = 'Furnishings' THEN o.sales ELSE 0 END) AS Furnishings,
  SUM(CASE WHEN o.sub_category = 'Labels' THEN o.sales ELSE 0 END) AS Labels,
  SUM(CASE WHEN o.sub_category = 'Machines' THEN o.sales ELSE 0 END) AS Machines,
  SUM(CASE WHEN o.sub_category = 'Paper' THEN o.sales ELSE 0 END) AS Paper,
  SUM(CASE WHEN o.sub_category = 'Phones' THEN o.sales ELSE 0 END) AS Phones
FROM tiger_data_engineering.global_superstore_gold.gold_orders o
GROUP BY o.category
ORDER BY o.category;
description: Unfiltered total sales by CATEGORY with each SUB_CATEGORY exposed as its own sales KPI column (sums over all data).
